_doc: All durations are hours, all scores are on the 0-100 relevance scale (config/relevance.json). Badges are recomputed from stored timestamps every time the API answers, so they expire on their own. 'breaking' also needs an event type from allowed_event_types, so an unclassified or low-value story can never be breaking.
_breaking_requirements: airline_financials is breaking only from a source with reliability >= 0.8 (airline IR/newsrooms, tier 1-2 trade media); finance-site stock commentary (0.7) is not.
